title: DevX orchestration & initiative tracker for SDKs, docs, and quickstarts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Create a single operational initiative that orchestrates roadmap milestones, success metrics, and rollout plans for the Developer Experience programs (official SDKs, docs, and quickstarts). This ticket drives a cross-functional tracking dashboard, defines OKRs, and codifies gating criteria used by PM/Eng/Design to progress features from prototype -> GA. Scope: 1) canonical initiative dashboard (Notion + Looker backing) with per-workstream milestones; 2) OKR mapping (adoption, time-to-first-request, error-free quickstart runs); 3) rollout runbook and canary gating for SDK releases and quickstart content; 4) signal contracts with infra/telemetry to ensure reliable metrics. Success criteria: consolidated dashboard in Notion + Looker query set; acceptance tests for quickstarts with >=90% pass rate in CI; SDK release checklist captured and automated where possible; documented rollback and fallback patterns for GA releases.
